title: Domino Apocalypse
description: A surreal apocalyptic scene featuring a glowing blue skeletal figure in a red cap holding lightning in one hand while standing on a stormy cloud. Oversized red and blue dominoes drip paint as they fall from a dark stormy sky with lightning and a blood-red eclipse. A chaotic roulette wheel vortex swirls in a broken red bridge, with floating skeletal figures, a winged blue grim reaper, and a man in blue robes on a wooden dock.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic city scene with a large glowing blue skeleton wearing a red baseball cap and purple glowing ribs, standing on a dark storm cloud while holding purple lightning. Giant red and blue dripping dominoes fall from a stormy sky with lightning bolts and a red eclipse. A swirling colorful roulette wheel vortex appears inside a crumbling red bridge. Winged blue grim reaper skeleton flies nearby, smaller dancing skeletons and a bearded man in blue robes stand on wooden planks over water, with ruined colorful buildings and the Colosseum in the background.
